description: This Java test class `ImmutableThingRevisionTest` contains unit tests for the `ImmutableThingRevision` class, verifying its immutability, equality, hash code, and comparison methods.

classes.name: ImmutableThingRevisionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for `ImmutableThingRevision`, testing immutability, equality, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance `underTest` with a fixed value before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: toLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the `toLong` method returns the expected value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the `toString` method returns the string representation of the internal long value.

methods.name: revisionIsLowerThanOther
methods.description: Tests that `isLowerThan` correctly identifies a lower revision.

methods.name: revisionIsGreaterThanOther
methods.description: Tests that `isGreaterThan` correctly identifies a higher revision.

methods.name: revisionIsLowerThanOrEqualToOther

methods.name: revisionIsGreaterThanOrEqualToOther
